messages:
jordan (Eng, SF): Planning to move my homebase to Austin starting June 1. Will be in SF office 2 days/week for ~3 months. Questions: how is WFH stipend handled for June (prorated?), what steps for payroll/state withholding, and any CA tax nexus risk?
meera (People Ops): Congrats! Please submit the Change Homebase form: https://redwood.internal/forms/change-homebase. Stipend is prorated by days in each homebase in the month. We'll confirm on payroll cutoff.
alex (Payroll): After form, we'll set TX as primary withholding. For days worked in CA, CA withholding may still apply; please note in timesheet or payroll comments which days are CA.
sasha (Legal): Short-term hybrid presence like 2 days/wk for several months usually doesn't create corporate nexus, but we monitor patterns. If this becomes persistent or more employees do the same we escalate to Finance/Tax.
payroll-bot: FYI: submit Change Homebase within 5 business days to avoid incorrect withholding.
jordan (Eng, SF): Thanks — filing form now and will annotate June timesheet. Manager will send schedule to People Ops for payroll estimate.
